oneOf.title: Page
oneOf.description: Full page of content, in the case of OCR-only data. Later becomes 'None' or 'No-type'.

oneOf.title: Article
oneOf.description: Textual unit(s) corresponding to a journalistic editorial unit.

oneOf.title: Table
oneOf.description: Tabular content presenting structured data or listings.

oneOf.title: Obituary
oneOf.description: Notice reporting a death, often including biographical information.

oneOf.title: Chronicle
oneOf.description: Broadcast chronicle reporting events in a factual or narrative form.

oneOf.title: Radio Bulletin
oneOf.description: Content item originating from a radio bulletin.

oneOf.title: Radio Broadcast Episode
oneOf.description: An individual episode or segment of a radio broadcast.

oneOf.title: No Type Provided
oneOf.description: Content item with no specific type provided (short version).

oneOf.title: Discussion
oneOf.description: Radio Broadcast discussion or talk show content item.
